asset: Human Skull — light source, Tear balanced derivative

origin.detail: Publisher discloses a Meshy AI image-to-3D base and textures, then cleanup, scaling, texturing and checks in Blender. This is not a photogrammetry scan or anatomical accuracy claim.

sourceFile.note: Source download removed after verification and derivation to avoid shipping12.5MB of unused high-resolution geometry. The rebuild script downloads it into memory on demand and verifies this pinned SHA256.

runtime.processing: Attribute-aware Meshoptimizer reduction followed by bounded spatial reduction of tiny source topology islands; original JPEG byte payloads unchanged. Original source bounds retained exactly. See prepare-balanced.mjs and BALANCED.json.
runtime.qualityLimits: Simplifier errors are algorithm estimates, not measured physical deviation. Browser silhouette/material review required. Do not infer anatomical accuracy from the publisher name or high source triangle count.
